questions.question: Which patriarch does Hosea 12 recall to call Israel back to God?
options: Moses, who led them out of Egypt

questions.question: What does Hosea 12 urge Israel to do?
options: Offer up still more sacrifices on the many high places throughout the land
Gather to themselves great riches and trade freely with the surrounding nations
Build up strong and high walls and raise a great and mighty army for defense
Return to God, hold fast to love and justice, and wait continually for him
questions.answer: Return to God, hold fast to love and justice, and wait continually for him
